summary: New SQL-018 spot-unlock hardening feature: 6 acceptance criteria covered by 5 browser checks + 1 new backend test file (9 assertions) + reran full existing backend suite (39 passed) + typecheck + yarn install --frozen-lockfile. No real Supabase credentials were available/used; the two auth-gated UI criteria (locked-panel price/balance, tap-protection/reveal) were still fully exercised using the repo's existing pattern of a fabricated JWT session placed in localStorage plus Playwright page.route interception of the Supabase REST/RPC endpoints (same technique already used by the pre-existing spot-unlock-150-coin-rule-mocked check) - no real account or production data was touched. All 7 checks/artifacts passed.

checks.criterion: Locked spot UI shows the server-derived unlock price and current balance
checks.name: locked-spot-shows-server-price-free-and-paid
checks.evidence: Mocked authenticated session + Supabase RPC routes on /fundort/tscheck-spot-price-preview-1. Scenario A (my_spot_unlock_preview -> free_remaining:8, cost:0): spot-locked-panel visible, coin-balance-display contains '40', spot-unlock-price text is exactly 'Free unlock', spot-unlock-button visible. Scenario B (unlocked_count:10, free_remaining:0, cost:150): coin-balance-display contains '16', spot-unlock-price text is exactly 'Unlock for 150 Coins'. Screenshots captured for both scenarios.

checks.criterion: Unlock action is protected against repeated taps and immediately reveals details
checks.name: unlock-button-disabled-pending-reveals-details
checks.evidence: Mocked unlock_spot RPC with 1.2s simulated latency. After first click: spot-unlock-button has aria-busy='true' and is disabled; a forced second click did not add a 2nd RPC call. After the RPC resolves: spot-locked-panel disappears (not.toBeVisible), full spot details (title + spot-like-button) render without a page reload, and exactly 1 unlock_spot call was recorded (unlockCalls===1) confirming the tap-guard held.

checks.criterion: User-facing unlock errors are understandable in both languages
checks.name: arcade.test.ts (src/lib/arcade.test.ts, pre-existing vitest unit test covering spotUnlockError)
checks.evidence: Verified by static code review of src/lib/arcade.ts + src/lib/i18n-en.ts: 42702/'ambiguous'/'column reference' -> message containing 'SQL 018' (DE) / 'spot unlock update SQL 018' (EN); INSUFFICIENT_COINS -> 'nicht genug Leonida Coins' (DE) / "don't have enough Leonida Coins" (EN); 'Failed to fetch'/network/57014 -> 'Guthaben wurde nicht verändert' (DE) / 'coin balance was not changed' (EN). All DE strings have matching EN entries in i18n-en.ts (lines 68-76, 681-682). The pre-existing unit test src/lib/arcade.test.ts already asserts exactly this mapping (3rd it-block: 'übersetzt Fundortfehler aus der Datenbank verständlich'), but `yarn vitest run` currently fails for EVERY spec in the repo (including unrelated i18n.test.ts) with 'Cannot find package @testing-library/dom imported from @testing-library/jest-dom' - a pre-existing, repo-wide vitest/dependency-resolution issue unrelated to this feature's code. `yarn install --frozen-lockfile` succeeds and does not pull in @testing-library/dom, so this is an environment gap, not something this feature introduced.

checks.criterion: Server-side migration contains exact atomic rules
checks.name: test_tscheck_sql018_migration_rules.py
checks.evidence: 9 pytest assertions against docs/migrations/018_spot_unlock_hardening.sql (pure static-file checks, no live DB call possible): unlock_spot is 'security definer'; EXECUTE revoked from public/anon and granted only to authenticated; wallet SELECT uses 'for update' on coin_wallets; charge formula is exactly 'case when unlocked_count < 10 or is_premium then 0 else 150 end'; insufficient balance raises INSUFFICIENT_COINS; insert has 'on conflict (user_id, spot_id) do nothing' + null-cost short-circuit for idempotency; insert->debit->ledger-insert ordering confirmed inside the single plpgsql function body; no 'disable row level security' statement present. `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_tscheck_sql018_migration_rules.py` -> 9 passed in 0.01s.

checks.criterion: Anonymous and invalid routes do not expose unlock data
checks.name: guest-map-no-unlock-panel-no-errors + invalid-spot-route-shows-not-found
checks.evidence: guest-map-no-unlock-panel-no-errors: logged-out /karte renders (map-logo visible), spot-locked-panel and spot-unlock-button both have count 0, no >=400 responses, no console errors. invalid-spot-route-shows-not-found: /fundort/tscheck-does-not-exist-999 shows 'Not found.' text, no locked panel/unlock button rendered, no >=400 responses, no console errors. Both passed.

checks.name: typecheck-install-health-publickey-admin401
checks.evidence: cd /app/frontend && yarn typecheck -> tsc --noEmit, Done, exit 0. cd /app && yarn install --frozen-lockfile -> 'success Already up-to-date.' exit 0. curl localhost:8001/api/health -> 200 {"status":"ok"}. curl localhost:8001/api/push/public-key -> 200 {"publicKey":"BEN6V2jC..."}. curl -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' localhost:8001/api/push/admin/status (no session) -> 401. Full backend pytest suite: 39 passed in 3.74s (includes the 9 new SQL-018 migration tests plus all 30 pre-existing tests, no regressions).

checks.criterion: Production root cause is documented without claiming an unrun database fix (cross-check: public preview smoke)
checks.name: public-preview-health-and-guest-map
checks.evidence: Against https://leonida-karte--6tt5kohx.preview.emergentagent.com/karte (public ingress): map-logo visible, spot-locked-panel count 0 for the logged-out visitor, no crash. No Supabase credentials were available or used, confirming no real-account/production mutation occurred during this test run - consistent with the briefing's note that SQL 018/015 must still be executed by the user in Lovable before a real-account unlock can be exercised end-to-end.

action_items: Repo-wide vitest suite is currently broken for ALL spec files (not just arcade.test.ts) with 'Cannot find package @testing-library/dom imported from @testing-library/jest-dom/dist/matchers-...mjs'. yarn install --frozen-lockfile succeeds and does not resolve it (transitive peer dependency of @testing-library/jest-dom is missing from node_modules). This pre-existing environment gap blocked running the existing unit test for criterion 3 (spotUnlockError bilingual mapping); the mapping was instead verified by direct source review of src/lib/arcade.ts and src/lib/i18n-en.ts, which matches the criterion exactly. Recommend adding @testing-library/dom as an explicit devDependency so `yarn vitest run` works again.

test_credentials_missing: no real Supabase user account/session is available to this environment (per briefing and /app/memory/test_credentials.md - 'Keine Test-Konten angelegt'), and SQL 018/015 have not been run against the shared production/preview Supabase project daxzwbkacxllrejaghym. End-to-end 0/16/10th/11th/149/150-coin real-RPC cases, and the physical iPhone/Capacitor session restoration flow, remain blocked until the user executes the migration in Lovable and supplies/creates a test account - exactly as flagged in spec_deviations. The browser checks in this report substitute a fully-mocked Supabase session/RPC layer (JWT in localStorage + page.route interception) to exercise the UI logic without touching real data; this proves the frontend wiring is correct but cannot prove the live SQL 018 function itself runs correctly in Supabase.
